dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 17, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MAJOR LEAGUE BASEBALL RECAP: DAY 15**

The Boston Red Sox continued their dominance behind a 10-0 rout of the Tampa Bay Rays, with Carlos Narváez leading the charge, going 3-for-4 with a home run and three RBIs. Jake Bennett pitched six scoreless innings to earn the win.

In another Red Sox victory, Griffin Jax took the loss as Boston took down Tampa Bay 5-3. Wilyer Abreu hit two home runs and drove in three runs for the Red Sox.

The Los Angeles Dodgers edged the New York Yankees 2-1, with Max Muncy hitting a go-ahead home run in the eighth inning off Gerrit Cole, who struck out eight in six innings.

In a blowout win, the Washington Nationals crushed the Athletics 23-4, with Andrés Chaparro going 4-for-5 with two home runs and eight RBIs. Cade Cavalli pitched six scoreless innings to earn the win.

The St. Louis Cardinals edged the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-4, with Luis Gastelum earning the win in relief. Corbin Carroll hit a home run for the Diamondbacks.

The San Francisco Giants shut out the Seattle Mariners 7-0, with Bryce Miller pitching 5.2 scoreless innings to earn the win. Willy Adames hit a grand slam for the Giants.

The Cincinnati Reds defeated the Colorado Rockies 7-2, with Spencer Steer hitting two home runs and driving in three runs. Brady Singer pitched seven scoreless innings to earn the win.

The Pittsburgh Pirates beat the Cleveland Guardians 7-1, with Jared Jones pitching five scoreless innings to earn the win. Jacob Gonzalez hit a home run for the Pirates.
